Hello Tiny Footballers!

New version v1.6, featuring:

More player customisation options - new hair colors (brown, blonde.. pink?), hair styles (mullet anyone?) and skin tones. Allows individual players to be picked out easier during a match. 

Swiss-system competition league/knockout - this is a competition that starts with a single league where each team enters a single league, the top teams qualify for the knockout, the next teams qualify for the playoffs, the rest go out. [*] Matches in wrong order during season mode
[*] Sometimes winner screen was not showing for season mode

Martyn

notes.title: Tiny Football v1.5 Update
notes.content:
Euro 2024 has kicked off, though my beloved Scotland took an absolute beating last night! But on a brighter note :) I’m excited to share some new features in version 1.5:

[b]Big Performance Enhancements[/b]

The main focus of this update is performance. Some of the larger workshop items were causing long delays between matches due to extensive calculations for scores, transfers, and player skill adjustments. I’ve optimised every database interaction, resulting in significantly reduced delays. This might seem like a behind-the-scenes improvement, but it’s crucial for a smoother gaming experience. 

I’ve also added some exciting new visible features:

[b]Top Goalscorer Screen[/b]

Now you can track the top goalscorers across tournaments and season modes. Enjoy more in-depth stats while playing!

[b]Group Stage League Screen[/b]

I’ve revamped the league screen for group stage competitions like the World Cup. You can now cycle through each group stage with a new button, allowing you to strategise and calculate what’s needed to progress.

[b]Improved Zonal Marking and Crossing[/b]

I’ve made improvements to zonal marking and crossing, enhancing gameplay dynamics.

[b]Bug Fixes and Minor Enhancements[/b]

As always, this update includes various bug fixes and minor enhancements to improve your gaming experience.

Also, don’t miss out on the new items added to the Steam Workshop from the last update. There’s some excellent content there to enjoy. Big shout out to the content contributors!

Enjoy the Euros!

notes.title: Available now.. Enhanced editor, Steam Workshop integration (and more)
notes.content:
This has been a long long update in the making but hopefully takes Tiny Football to a new level with limitless content and community engagement. With a new editor and workshop integration, players can not create and share content in Tiny Football. Much of the data structure in the game had to be refactored and a ton of testing (thank you to all those who participated in testing!) and bug fixing!

[b]Big changes[/b]

Enhanced editor - now players can create and edit their own teams, competitions and seasons. If a competition doesn't exist in the game, create your own!

Steam Workshop integration - In addition to the enhanced editor, Steam Workshop integration allows players to share their created content with other players.

See all Workshop items here - https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=1887010


[b]Other additions[/b]

Less strict referees - less fouls, more bad decisions.. more gameplay, more fun.

Fixed some issues with players not getting into goal area when ball in crossing zone.

New jump animation - now players have the ability to jump an incoming tackle if their dribbling skill level is notably higher than the tackling player. Leads to some cool dribbling runs past defending players.

And bug fixes, as always

I look forward to seeing your creations in the editor and Steam Workshop!

notes.title: Update notes for v1.3
notes.content:
Version 1.3 has a new look to the menus as well as a ton of work done to support multiple languages - as well as the addition of Chinese and Japanese. 

Full list of features below:

[b]Revamped menus[/b]

Gameplay menus have a new dark theme to differentiate from the home menu and other setup screen’s light theme.

[b]Watch computer vs computer matches[/b]

I had a lot of fun with this feature and I think it added a more competition edge to even single player gameplay. From the fixtures screen, players can click on other matches they wish to watch. For example, if your team reaches the semi final you can watch the other computer vs computer match in real time to see what team you’ll meet in the final match. Or watch the Manchester derby match that’s playing alongside your own team’s match.

[b]Full translations across entire game[/b]

Translations since early release have been somewhat patchy. The list of items needing translations has grown, also the previous font didn’t support all languages (Russian, Chinese, Japanese). Now all items (buttons, info labels, team names etc) have been added to the translation maps and fonts have been updated to support all character encoding.

[b]Add Chinese and Japanese languages[/b]

Now our gamer friends in China and Japan can enjoy Tiny Football :)

[b]Upgrade stadium to have corner stands for clubs competing in Europe[/b]

As your team progresses through the league divisions (English only, for now) your stadium will grow to reflect your team’s growing support base. Corner stands fit more supporters.

[b]Use thread to create new season[/b]

The games will take a short moment to create a new season. This is now handled on a separate thread and doesn’t stall the game in the process.

[b]Fix marquee text on some menu items[/b]

[b]Fix match menu bug when cancel button pressed crashes gameplay[/b]

...plus many more bug and minor enhancements

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2 brings lower league divisions to season mode (English only, for now) as well as enhancements to stadiums, supporters and stands, to enhance the match experience. 

[b]New English league divisions added to season mode[/b]

Added English lower league divisions and new teams. This allows players to select a lower division side and work up the division to the top division and european competition. Teams that do not perform well, will be relegated to lower divisions. Other country divisions will be added in a future update too, just added English for now.

[b]Randomly generated stadiums[/b]

Stadiums will be randomly generated for lower division teams. For example, a division 3 side may just have a couple of standing stands and fenced sides. Division 2 sides will have a combination of seating and standing stands. Added new seating graphics too. Division 1 teams will have all seater stadiums, with the top teams having corner sections too. Makes each game against new opponents a little more varied.

[b]Enhanced supporters[/b]

Each supporter is an individual character and will respond to what is happening on the park. When the home team scores, the home supporters will jump and shout whereas the away supporters will stand idle with the occasional protest toward their team.

Added proper team colours to supporters too

[b]Friendly matches in season mode[/b]

Before each league campaign, teams will play a few friendly matches against foreign opposition. Fun for lower league teams who won’t get the chance to play in the top european competition (well, not until you get them promoted and qualified for it)

[b]Numerous bug fixes/ minor enhancements[/b]

[list]
[*] Thrown shirt remaining on park
[*] Squad button not hidden when no human teams selected for tournament
[*] Add goalie colours to goalies during squad selection
[*] Cup round not being created thus crashing the game at the end of the season
[*] Player too much on park for throw in
[*] Remove strange characters in play names e.g. ¼ and |
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for v1.1
notes.content:
[b]Edit competition names in editor[/b]

All competition names can be changed to something new. E.g. Euro Club Cup -> Euro Champs League.

[b]New blue slide banner for goals, fouls etc during match[/b]

This replaces the black ticker that was a feature on previous versions. Looks somewhat sleeker IMO.

[b]Ball trail effect[/b]

Ball trail added to the path of the ball. Makes swerves and passing plays stand out more. 

[b]More money for progression in Euro Club Cup in season mode[/b]

Teams will now be rewarded with more spending money the following season for progressing in the Euro Club Cup. This includes a win during the group stages, qualifying for the following season’s tournament, bigger prizes for each knockout stage.

[b]Award prize money for winning domestic trophies[/b]

Get money for winning the domestic league or cup in season mode

[b]Line up players in view for penalties[/b]

Players will celebrate their team scoring or saving a penalty and when declared the winning team will run to the corner flag to celebrate.

[b]Create next season on separate thread and loading progress bar[/b]

Displays a progress bar for status whilst players are being retired, created etc. Required when there is a delay between seasons to show the game has crashed!

[b]Create more transfer bids at the start of a new season[/b]

Similar to a real season where clubs do most of their bidding during the summer when the transfer window is open. Let clubs spend their updated transfer budget.

[b]Fix bug where random offers for players not happening[/b]

Small code typo meant that clubs weren’t bidding for players that weren’t transfer listed

[b]Fix bug where players don’t retire quick enough [/b]

Players don’t retire quickly enough so that they just keep on ageing. After 20+ seasons players are in their 50s/60s. Also, player values were not displaying correctly - showing negative values for much older players. This has been fixed.

[b]Fix bugs in player selection screen[/b]

Cursor wasn’t showing correctly. Also, sometimes player swap wasn’t working (swapping wrong player)

notes.title: Update notes for v1.0
notes.content:
A little late with this update as had to go back to the code to fix some issues identified during testing. But this is 1.0 as intended. Mainly team squad updates, performance enhancements, bug fixes and tidy ups.

[b]Update club and national squad players[/b]

A massive job for me to do this first time, a simple process in future. This updates all club/ national teams to their current squads as players move around etc. Ideally I want to be able to update this twice a year, so required a build process in place to make this an easier task - I hope to update the game at the end of each transfer window. At these times, players will have changed clubs and I want the game to reflect this changes. I have built a process to allow me to fetch all the updated squads for every team, then generate database migrations that I can ship out with each update. This way, it will update the game without having to delete saved tournaments, edited player names etc.

[b]Process match fixtures on a separate thread[/b]

This is to enhance performance and speed up the lag experienced between fixtures screen and displaying results. Will build upon this in future updates to enhance performance further.

[b]Process migrations on a separate thread[/b]

The game stalls when database migrations are running, this just ensures that the game is still responsive and I can do things like showing a progress bar whilst updates are running.

[b]Fix bug where transfer list doesn't fill up after a few seasons[/b]

For some reason, the transfer market wasn't filling up after a couple of seasons - especially with defenders and goalies! I've re-written this section to ensure this works correctly now. 

[b]Add scrolling to text that spills out of boxes[/b]

Some team names and player names are just too long for my small boxes. I've added text scrolling so that they fit more neatly. 

[b]Add scrolling to news screen when there are many news items[/b]

Now the news screen will automatically scroll vertically when there are many news items to show -player transfers, players returning from injury/suspension etc

[b]Update season transfer menu buttons/ team selection[/b]

Updated to newer style. Still have the editor menus to do next.

..and lots of additional refactoring and bug fixes, too many to mention them all, as always! :)

notes.title: Early Access to Full Release v1.0, all features added to date
notes.content:
Tiny Football is reaching a significant milestone as it comes out of 6 months of Early Access into full release, version 1.0. This is a round up of all features that have been added to the game in that time. I'm very grateful to all those who have contributed feedback and taken an interest in the game. And the work doesn't stop now, I'll continue to put out updated versions with new features and fixes, as well as taking ideas from players.

[b]Enhancements to gameplay[/b]

I improved the AI of the opposing team, making them more challenging to play against, less predictable and working more defensively using zonal marking. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41862718/cb2d4b3cdc01c53883939ff5261b04e32f43634d.png[/img]

Additionally, players will make attacking runs after passing. Visually this makes off the ball players appear less static than before but more importantly they are working together as a team whether defending or attacking.

[b]Season enhancements[/b]

More countries have been added to the season mode in addition to English club teams. So far I've added German, French, Italian, Spanish and Scottish. 

I also added a new feature that allows players to buy and sell players during the transfer window to enable squad building. Also, players now age and retire as well as new players coming up through the youth squads adding a slight managerial feel to the game, whilst keeping it fun and simple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41862718/c3c8c38652d4d54f0ceee0c8a067b23ee8b85ef2.jpg[/img] 

[b]Improving the user interface (UI)[/b]

I wanted to make the game more visually appealing for players. I added a new main menu screen, which allows players to easily navigate through different game modes, such as quick match, season mode, and tournaments. 

Team selection screens got a major face lift with animated carousel sliders to choose national and club teams from various countries. I also improved the layout of options screen prior to each match to allow users to set options there and then, as well as choose team colours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41862718/d1e2231a83b8f7037f120fd3eac6c2c5f428c0e8.png[/img]

An updated player selection screen allows better visualisation of formation on the pitch. A new squad selection screen during match fixtures has been added to allow changing of squad and tactics between matches.

[b]Addition of female players and Women's World Cup[/b]

In addition to the existing Men's World Cup, I've added a Women's World Cup to allow players to compete in either of these prestigious events... just in time for the Women's World Cup 2023 kicking off in Australia and New Zealand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41862718/aa8dfc0f1f4005d3742a09895841883b984ebb03.png[/img]

Overall, I am excited to introduce these new features to Tiny Football and hope that players will enjoy them. I believe that the improvements to the UI, gameplay, and game modes will enhance the overall player experience and make Tiny Football even more fun to play. And with a long list of features yet to come, I'm looking forward to what new additions I can add over the next few months.

[h2]Continued support and additional features[/h2]

Finally, I'd like to mention that I will continue to build upon the progress made so far. I've still a host of additions I'm keen to add. In fact, I already have the next update in beta testing and plan on following up with more. I still enjoy developing the game and watching it grow so watch this space for new and exciting features.

notes.title: Update notes for v0.0.7
notes.content:
[b]Player transfers[/b]
It is now possible, during season mode, to buy and sell players to strengthen squad. When buying, place a bid for a player and await the club to respond. Players can be listed on the transfer market for a quicker sale. Browsing the transfer market for a bargain player, or browse teams and bid direct on players - expect to pay a little more.

[b]Rebase exception player skill levels[/b]
This means that some players in a team have more exceptional ability e.g. star players. Star players will be more noticeable faster, better shooting etc than other team mates.

[b]Hair and skin colours[/b]
Updated all season mode country club teams with more accurate representable of real life player skin and hair colours. 

[b]Attacking runs after passing[/b]
Whilst in possession, players will make attacking/triangular runs. The skill aspect is timing the pass with the players run. Can lead to some nice attacking moves to beat the defenders or get into a good crossing position.

[b]Zonal marking[/b]
When not in possession, players will mark zonally and move with players to retain a good defensive position.

notes.title: Update notes for v0.0.6
notes.content:
[b]Players age, they get old, they retire[/b]
At the end of each season, older players (late thirties) will retire as they age. With age also brings a gradual decline in skill level over time. 

[b]Youth players added to squad[/b]
As players are getting older and dropping out from retirement, younger players are added to the squad. Currently this just happens to replace those lost through retirement.

[b]New French and Scottish club season mode[/b]
Play with Glasgow Green or Paris in their respective domestic tournaments.

[b]News screen[/b]
With players retiring and new players joining, seemed necessary to have a screen to report these updates. Also, when players return from injury/suspension it'll be announced here.

notes.title: MicroProse announces 5 New Games!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/055da8dbdf3255b96d5ace29fbbd4e12efa62d16.jpg[/img]

Hello MicroProse fans!
We are back at announcing new games that join our line-up. This time it's all about stories, atmosphere, exploration, but also intrigue and even sport!

Let's take a look at each one of them.

[h1][b]Neyyah[/b][/h1]
Neyyah is a first-person [b]point-and-click adventure[/b] game from solo developer, Aaron Gwynaire.
You are thrown into a strange secretive world called Neyyah. Use careful observation and logic to uncover the mysteries entwined within Neyyah's peculiar landscapes and bizarre cultures.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/de8135a673b6143005c795f6e183850cd8986f25.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/39ebb57779f238c975c92b6ac1118d57504a9cef.jpg[/img]

Neyyah is set within a collection of remote almost abandoned islands, separated by a series of complex portal machinery and laced with the fingerprints of two very intriguing cultures.
Upon waking up from a strange dream, you find yourself transported to a place called Olujay, where you meet Vamir, who sends you to Neyyah in the hope you will be safe there. For reasons you will discover upon your many explorations, Vamir needs you for a matter of great urgency.

[i]A wrong must be righted. A civilization avenged. A secret revealed.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289720/

[h1][b]Let Bions Be Bygones[/b][/h1]
[i]"Welcome to the planet Terrahive. A planet that never should have existed. Completely encrusted in a disease called humanity. Corporate arcologies and space elevators shadow the layers of polluted man-made edifices. Overseen by ancient brains on apparatuses and driven by greed, corruption, progress, and immortality." [/i]- John Cooper

Let Bions be Bygones is an [b]atmospheric narrative future-noir thriller.[/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/b8a3cf3f6b0f28de942468b7b30d5e7d4cd3c5ff.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/a107fc4637a785d041ab6f24ca69c3a3aa07515f.jpg[/img]

A new take on the classic genre, Let Bions be Bygones, lets the players focus on the [b]story[/b], [b]narrative[/b], and [b]detective work[/b].  Players will be able to choose their own path and grow their characters through different playstyles.
All this and more, in a gritty world captivated by an original, unique soundtrack and a professional voice-over that will immerse the player in a thrilling tale with multiple endings.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1347560/

[h1][b]CrossOver: Roll for Initiative[/b][/h1]

CrossOver is a [b]tabletop RPG strategy[/b] game.
Defend your tabletop RPG paper character sheet from invading pixel enemies! Find matches in your tray of dice to power attacks to clear the evil from your shelf full of campaign books. Hardcore match-3 RPG puzzle meets action-strategy tower defence.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/b0ba7db416383b0d3b2b1b683567d52a1a52acea.jpg[/img][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/474a4ea83cc8961bac62b6c123dcef92e9a282eb.jpg[/img]

CrossOver takes some classic concepts from traditionally “casual” genres (Match 3 and Tower Defence) and crosses them into a new and eccentric hardcore challenge with [b]Strategy, RPG and Puzzle elements.[/b]

The main campaigns include RPG progression, dozens of spells and weapons to find, mercenaries to hire, and shops to buy armor and items. Random encounters appear between stages with Fighting Fantasy book style choices. Earn persistent gems to unlock more classes/races (15 of each in the game) or trade in for extra gold during any campaign.
Try your hand at the [b]Solo [/b]and [b]Co-Op Endless Modes[/b] to challenge the Online Leaderboards!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1713080/

[h1][b]Drop[/b][/h1]
DROP is a rogue-like [b]hacking simulator[/b] set in a fragmented future.
You are a freelancer, trying to gain fame in DROP, an anonymous system for hackers. You break into digital enclaves and leave without a trace, but you find yourself in a conflict between various agencies that could change the world.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/06ea7e67a38903c2b0e3d6cc821293dec5132b7c.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/2fea9c67c8a40a3ebac24b9f51129817292d33a6.jpg[/img]

Enter a disconnected cyberpunk world – the unique visuals, exclusive soundtrack, and electronic soundscapes evoke the feel and the thrill of hacking in a potential future. Play an unfolding story campaign through unique missions.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902300/

[h1][b]Tiny Football[/b][/h1]

[i]Tackle, Pass and Shoot your way to the back of the net.
On the Couch or Online. Settle old scores![/i]

Tiny Football is a throwback to old [b]top-down retro soccer games of the 90s.[/b] Master the art of passing and shooting, tackles, crosses, throw balls, overhead kicks, free kicks, and more. Compete with 64 national and club teams in a variety of tournaments.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/b87e7dcabe43e485438b59d10c5a254572b4632e.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37756818/d12fe24f8de97acca6ea04f9473680bce92c36cc.jpg[/img]

Rich gameplay and real challenge is achieved by sharing user control with AI assistance to produce passing and shooting based on individual player ability.
Each squad member has their own skill levels and players can be pre-selected before a match and substituted during a match when they are tired.
In-match injuries will force substitutions. Sent off players and player suspensions will force players to shuffle team selection adding a managerial feel to tournaments.

Additional features include goal celebrations, player protests, extra time and penalties. Play with a friend (controller and keyboard) or the computer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887010/
